title: Self 2
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. THE MOST SQUEEZED NODE ON THE PATH. Its predecessor b1_self (36) is itself a mixed bag — body words (ache, painful, dizzy, swollen, bruise, wound, heal, cure), emotions (anxious, guilty, ashamed, grateful, relieved, furious, frustrated, exhausted) and traits (stubborn, ambitious, sensitive, loyal, selfish, modest, outgoing) — and every one of those three areas has since been taken by a B2 unit drafted EARLIER TODAY on this same lane: b2_health has the medical layer, b2_feelings the emotions, b2_personality the traits. The corrected sweep caught four words at once that the shipped pool cannot see — **discipline** (leaf_family_b2), **resilience** (leaf_feelings_b2), **role model** (leaf_family_b2) and **acceptance** (b2_suffixes_1). Without that check this unit would have been a patchwork of things taught hours before. What is genuinely left, and it is a real B2 area, is the INNER self: how you see yourself (identity, self-esteem, self-worth, self-belief, self-doubt, self-aware, inner voice, gut feeling, intuition, vulnerability, authenticity), what makes you act (motivation, willpower, drive, perseverance, ambition, potential, mindset, comfort zone, prioritise, strong and weak points), and how you look back on it (personal growth, maturity, reflect, hindsight, turning point, milestone, setback, achievement, fulfilment, work-life balance). None of that is a feeling, a trait or a symptom, so nothing collides. A12 sense on drive (inner) — the car reading is the commoner one and is already taught. E10 Use is rewrite production.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Self 1 mixed three things together: the body, the emotions and the character words. Since then Health 3 has taken the body, Feelings 4 the emotions and Personality 3 the character. What is left for this unit is the part none of them covers — how you see yourself, what makes you act, and how you look back on the years.
cards.note_cz: Self 1 míchal tři věci dohromady: tělo, emoce a povahová slova. Od té doby vzalo Health 3 tělo, Feelings 4 emoce a Personality 3 povahu. Pro tuhle lekci zbývá to, co nepokrývá ani jedna z nich — jak se vidíš, co tě žene a jak se díváš zpět.

cards.title: The self- words
points: **self-** always takes a hyphen and always points back at the person.
Two of these are nouns and two are adjectives — the ending tells you which.

rows: noun — how much you value yourself
noun — whether you think you can
adjective — you notice your own habits
adjective — you feel watched, and not in a good way
